entities.summary: Echezonachukwu Chinedu Nduka is a Nigerian poet, pianist, author, recording artist, and ethnomusicologist specializing in African pianism by West African composers. His work has been featured on BBC, Radio Nacional Clasica de Argentina, Radio France International (rfi), and Classical Journey.
